name: bridger: WESTERN (CMOON)
desc:
Mankind in their expansion west have settled within Ridge. B Valley, a grueling and untouched wilderness rumored to hold an ancient curse. Beasts hunt and forces beyond mortal reach skulk these grounds, their chaos trapped and anchored by those who came long before them.

Your place within the valley is yet to be decided,  whatever path you choose to walk down danger remains a constant.

-Basic Controls-
Q - Quick dash 
W+W - Sprint 
R - Reload (With Weapon)
M1 - Fire (With weapon)
M2 - Aim in (With weapon) 
G - Melee (With weapon)
X - Ocular Prowess 
C - Fists 
F - Block (With fists out)
M - Statistics Menu 
H - Summon/Unsummon horse
N - Ride horse/Dismount

MAKE SURE TO HAVE A CLIPPING SOFTWARE SUCH AS MEDAL, SHADOWPLAY ETC IF YOU WOULD LIKE TO BE UNBANNED FROM ANTICHEAT.
(This game is in Early Alpha, meaning that everything is work in progress, and subject to change.)

Some clothing in game is made by Blotnik
